description: This course is designed for graduate students in mathematics. It studies topology using algebraic methods. It covers the following major topics: simplicial and singular homology, degree, cellular homology, Mayer-Vietoris sequences, homology with coefficients, Eilenberg-Steenrod axioms, categories and functors, cohomology groups, universal coefficient theorem, cup product, Künneth formula, orientation of manifolds, cohomology with compact support, Poincaré duality theorem.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate DegreeTHEN( must have completed MA3201 at a grade of at least AANDmust have completed MA4266 at a grade of at least A)
prerequisiteAdvisory: There is no prerequisite required for graduate students. Undergraduate students not meeting the prerequisite can seek departmental approval to enrol.
